one_line: An elite 5th-century CE master builder overseeing the top‑down excavation and planning of the Ajanta caves in the Waghora gorge.

appearance.age_look: Early 30s, lean but strong build, wiry arms and shoulders from manual work, medium height.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, warm medium-brown complexion, high cheekbones, faint freckles and stone dust marks, a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache; default expression is focused and calm, with sharp, observant eyes that soften when explaining plans.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a high, tidy topknot at the back of the crown, with a narrow cloth headband in dull red wrapped once around the forehead to keep sweat and dust away; a few short loose strands at the temples.
appearance.costume: He wears a practical yet respectable Deccan artisan’s outfit: a knee-length off‑white cotton tunic with half sleeves and a simple round neck slit slightly at the front, bordered at cuffs and hem with a narrow dull-red woven band; over his left shoulder is a plain, unpatterned light-brown cotton shawl (uttariya) used as a dust cloth and for modesty; his lower garment is a tightly wrapped, ankle-length cotton dhoti in muted indigo, pleated in front and tucked securely at the waist with a simple brown cloth belt; he has a small cotton pouch tied at his right hip; feet are in sturdy brown leather sandals with toe loops and straps; jewellery is minimal and work-safe—one small copper earring in each ear and a slim copper bangle on his right wrist, plus a simple thread around his neck with a tiny copper amulet tucked under the tunic; subtle stone dust and wear marks on the clothing show he works on site.
appearance.signature: A long iron measuring rod and straight-edge combined tool, about the length of his arm, with a slightly thicker grip wrapped in dark-brown leather, carried in his right hand, and a rolled palm-leaf plan tucked under his left arm showing faint grid lines and cave elevation sketches.

ref_desc: A lean, medium-brown man in his early 30s with an oval face, short beard, black hair in a topknot with a dull-red headband, wearing an off-white half-sleeve tunic, light-brown shoulder shawl, muted indigo ankle-length dhoti, brown sandals, minimal copper jewellery, carrying a leather-gripped iron measuring rod and a rolled palm-leaf plan in a palette of off-white, dull red, muted indigo, light brown and dark brown.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of a 5th-century Ajanta rock-cut engineer: a lean, medium-brown man in his early 30s with an oval face, sharp observant eyes, a short neat beard and moustache, and thick black hair pulled into a high topknot held by a narrow dull-red headband, with a few loose strands at the temples. Show him front, side and back in one image. He wears an off-white cotton knee-length tunic with half sleeves and a simple round neck slightly slit at the front, edged at cuffs and hem with a narrow dull-red woven band; over his left shoulder is a plain light-brown cotton shawl used like a work cloth, draped modestly. His lower garment is a tightly wrapped, ankle-length muted indigo cotton dhoti, pleated in front and firmly tucked at the waist, secured with a simple brown cloth belt from which a small cotton pouch hangs on the right. On his feet are sturdy brown leather sandals with toe loops and straps. Add minimal, practical jewellery: one small copper earring in each ear, a slim copper bangle on his right wrist, and a simple neck thread with a tiny copper amulet suggested under the tunic. Dust and slight wear on the garments hint at constant labor in the rock-cut caves. His signature tools are a long iron measuring rod and straight-edge combined, with a dark-brown leather-wrapped grip, held in his right hand, and a rolled palm-leaf plan with faint grid lines and cave elevation sketches tucked under his left arm. Use a palette dominated by off-white, dull red, muted indigo, light brown and dark brown, and keep the overall design historically grounded and modest while clearly anime in line and energy.
